newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Amsteel signs pact with BAT unit.
newsitem.headline: Amsteel signs pact with BAT unit.

text.p: Malaysian stockbroking firm Amsteel Capital Holdings (M) Sdn Bhd on Monday signed a joint venture agreement with Britain's Threadneedle Asset Management Ltd carry out fund management activities in Malaysia.
Officials told reporters that the joint venture company was expected to be allowed by Malaysian authorities to manage around 200 million ringgit in funds.
The paid up capital of the proposed joint venture company would be two million ringgit.
"The joint venture represents the group's first foray into the fund management business," said parent company Lion Corp Bhd in a statement.
Amsteel Capital Holdings is a unit of Amsteel Corp Bhd.
Threadneedle Asset Management is wholly-owned by Britain's BAT Industries Plc.
The company said the fund management company would be fully operational by the third quarter of 1997.
